hypothesis: A non-collapsed parameter-matched Patch-DeepONet can be trained from scratch under the same train-only frame and effective-update contract, enabling a fair paired fixed-19-Hz comparison with r5b.
mechanism: A spatially preserving branch and compact query trunk retain the DeepONet branch-trunk interaction while avoiding the information bottleneck and dense-query cost of a textbook globally pooled branch.

entry_gate.records: one deterministic record from each of uniform, layered, and marmousi
entry_gate.failure_signal: non-finite output, any record at or above the zero-prediction floor, or any registered error threshold exceeded

full_training.selection: fixed 48-record train-only panel with 32 exact stored frames

paired_comparison.superiority_rule: all three Holm-adjusted paired slice-level endpoints favor r5b, with favorable interpolation and outside-range mean directions

rollback: Preserve all artifacts, mark the failed tier terminal, do not open comparison references, and do not promote a collapsed baseline.
disk_policy: Keep one entry checkpoint and one best full checkpoint. Use temporary storage for sealed dense predictions, then retain manifests, scores, digests, and selected display arrays only.
